definitions.explanation: A tool used to open metal cans. Also called {缶開|かんあ}け (kanake).

examples.japanese: {缶切|かんき}りで{缶詰|かんづめ}を{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: I opened the canned food with a can opener.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{缶詰|かんづめ}は{缶切|かんき}りが{要|い}らないものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many canned foods nowadays don't require a can opener.

examples.japanese: キャンプに{缶切|かんき}りを{持|も}っていくのを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to bring a can opener camping.

notes:
FORMATION:
{缶|かん} (can) + {切|き}り (from {切|き}る, to cut)

Literally 'can-cutter.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{缶切|かんき}りで{開|あ}ける - to open with a can opener
・{缶切|かんき}りが{要|い}る - to need a can opener

RELATED WORDS:
・{缶詰|かんづめ} - canned food
・プルタブ - pull tab
・{栓|せん}{抜|ぬ}き - bottle opener

MODERN USAGE:
Traditional can openers are less common now as many cans have pull tabs ({開|あ}け{口|くち}), but {缶切|かんき}り is still used for certain types of cans.
